notes: two isnads for the same book, each its own group; the text writes the names in each, so there is no shared tail
rule 11: the book is cited through its author, Ya'qub b. 'Athim, the last link of both routes; whether the report's chain stops at the book's author is for the ruling
«عن أبي» is the compiler's father, a relation (not written in full); «- رضي اللّه عنه -» and «- رحمه اللّه -» are blessings, left out
